Elena Voss  
Staff Platform Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Architecture | GlobalEcom Solutions  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 52 345 6789 | elena.voss@goalecom.com | linkedin.com/in/elena-voss  

**Professional Summary**  
A seasoned platform engineer with 14 years of experience in designing and scaling cloud-native infrastructure for high-growth e-commerce platforms. Specialized in multi-cloud architectures, automation, and cost optimization. Proven track record in leading global infrastructure transformations, establishing governance frameworks, and mentoring cross-functional teams. Currently driving GlobalEcom Solutions’ cloud-native strategy to support 100M+ monthly active users.
